Background: The Xenon have seized Kha'ak jump technology and are using it to funnel forces from beyond the gate network into known space, setting a chain of disasters in motion. You are about to uncover the first piece of their plot.\n\nGameplay: Pilot a frigate against fighter-class ships, defend a station, and cripple the engines of enemy capital ships.

Finally shook the Xenon. Took long enough.
Who the hell decided to send us somewhere like this? Shouldn't this be an Intervention Corps problem?
We're deep in Xenon territory. If the Corps wants to push in here, they'll have to bleed for it.
So what exactly are we doing here again?
According to Shiratori: head to the marked area, drop a long-range satellite, confirm hive activity, then get back to Saturn Station and grab a drink.
Yeah... if only it were ever that simple.
Satellite deployed. Ship AI, begin the readout.
Receiving telemetry now. Estimated completion time: twenty seconds.
Once the numbers are in, we can head home. Wonder if the beer festival at Saturn Station is still going...
Warning: Xenon vessels detected ahead. Range: thirty kilometres.
Xenon...? No way.
Doesn't matter. Weapons hot.
That's done. Ship AI, start parsing the satellite data.
Parsing now.
No qualifying Kha'ak station detected in the vicinity.
Nothing? Wasn't this supposed to be one of the biggest Kha'ak hives in the whole damned universe?
Maybe our coordinates are off. Widen the search.
Search radius expanded. Wreckage detected: Kha'ak Ravager-class guardian. No hive structure detected.
A Ravager... wreck? You're saying something killed it?
Unable to identify the attacker. Non-Kha'ak energy residue detected.
Xenon?
Residual signal shows partial overlap with Xenon energy signatures. Unknown spatial-fold readings also present.
Spatial-fold readings? What the hell are the Xenon up to?
See if there's anything else in there.
Anomalous signal detected in the distance. Signal pattern does not match a gate, accelerator, or conventional Kha'ak jump residue.
Mark it. We take a look, then we get out.
That's a Xenon I... Why the hell is a Xenon capital ship all the way out here?
The Xenon don't usually send an I somewhere like this unless...
Warning: high-energy spatial fold detected.
What the hell is happening?
Unable to localise. The signal is coming from the entire debris field.
Where... where are we?
Star map recalibration complete. Current position: Savage Spur I.
Savage Spur I?! That's a Xenon core sector! We were just in the Mists of Artemis...
Inference: this ship was dragged in by an anomalous spatial fold.
So the Xenon got jump technology out of that Kha'ak hive... If there are Xenon forces outside the gate network...
Forget that. Look ahead.
Multiple large ship groups detected exiting spatial fold.
We can't stay here. Savage Spur I has a one-way accelerator to Savage Spur II. There's a TER outpost on the other side.
...Right. Move. Now.
Hold on... something's happening.
That many I-class ships... There aren't even this many in the whole gate network...
This is the Savage Spur II outpost. Unauthorised vessels, identify yourselves immediately. Wait... Sunborn Militia? Weren't you assigned to the Mists of Artemis?
No time to explain. The Xenon are coming.
Uploading sensor records now.
...Data received. Damn it. The defence crews are all back at Saturn Station getting drunk.
Then we're screwed. Maybe we should just run for it...
Ten minutes! Just buy us ten damn minutes! The Defence Minister said that after ten minutes, either the fleet gets here or his head rolls; one of the two!
Ten minutes? ...Fine. Let's just hope it's the fleet.
Warning: extra-large vessel signature detected. Identified as Xenon I.
No. No, no, no... that's an I.
Attention: Xenon K closing on the station.
We don't have the firepower to break a K's shields. Hit the engines and keep it off the station!
Warning: extra-large vessel signature detected. Identified as Xenon I.
No. No, no, no... that's another I.
We're done. The outpost is finished this time.
This is the Terran Intervention Corps battleship Paradigm. Sorry we're late. Looks like you've had quite the party. More reinforcements are already coming through the gate.
Threat eliminated. Repeat, threat eliminated. Stand down from red alert. All units, maintain patrol status.
To the two Sunborn Militia pilots: you have our thanks. We've already pulled the sensor records from your ship computers.
The Xenon are using Kha'ak jump technology. If they can keep pulling reinforcements in from beyond the gate network, human civilisation is well and truly screwed.
Drinks at Saturn are on me, so help yourselves. Just don't overdo it. The Intervention Corps staff and the Defence Ministry still want a full report from both of you.
Warning: first Xenon attack wing is closing fast.
At least these are still the small ones.

Background: Using stolen jump technology, the Xenon are funnelling ever more forces into the gate network, and Tharka's Cascade is taking the brunt of it.
Since HAT needed ARG's help to resolve the Scale Plate Pact crisis, it has effectively become an Argon vassal—one expected to pay in blood when asked. The 86th Escort Fleet is one such payment.
The 86th once saved your life. Now ARG means to spend them as cannon fodder, and you are determined to keep them alive, whatever the cost.
Gameplay: Command a frigate fleet remotely (OOS) and put its anti-fighter and anti-capital capabilities to the test.

Morning, Commander. All quiet in Tharka's Cascade.
Morning, Rayna. Same as usual today—see if anyone needs a hand.
Same as yesterday, then? Remind me, how many Xenon did we bag on that "routine patrol"?
Lost count of the Ms and PEs. Plus a K—that one was a right pain.
After all that, ARG owes us something, surely. Maybe they could finally send those supplies they've been sitting on?
Uh...
The crews are saying the new Cerberuses are already coming apart at the seams—like someone hauled them straight out of a scrapyard.
I'll... see what else I can squeeze out of them. You know things haven't been the same between ARG and HAT since you went "legitimate".
I know. That's why they stuck us out here in the first place. Anyway, let's get the patrol done.
Mayday! Mayday! Under Xenon attack! Engines are down—requesting immediate assistance...
86th Escort Command here. Our ships are on the way. Hold on for one minute!
Don't worry, Commander. Our defence drones will make short work of the small fry, and the plasma turrets will stay on that Xenon K.
Commander, that TEL captain wants a word. Says you're old friends.
Sounds like one of my contacts in TEL. Put them through.
Well, well—if it isn't the commander of the 86th. I swear your fleet gets smaller every time I see it.
Hardly a match for your mighty escort fleet. Remind me—where did you find that optical camouflage of theirs?
All right, all right, walked right into that one. Seriously, though—thanks for the rescue.
If you really want to thank me, find me some better gear. That last batch was rough. Which pirate did you dig it up from?
Argon have been breathing down my neck lately. You're lucky I found you anything that could shoot. Besides, you're the one who insisted on frigates.
The Xenon are hitting harder by the day. Fighters don't last in Tharka's radiation, and you know what kind of shape HAT's 86th is in.
Lucky for them they've got a first-rate mug like you, funding your own job. Still don't know why you're so damn determined to protect the 86th.
Mayday! Mayday! The station is under Xenon attack, and they've brought capital ships!
HAT miner calling! Both us and the station are under Xenon attack! We need support!
Commander, the TEL freighter has its engines back. It's ready to withdraw.
Good. Send it towards the southern gate. Rayna, clear the hostiles around the miner, then double back and reinforce the station.
Understood. I'll cover their withdrawal, then head straight for the miner.
Copy that. Making for the gate now. I'll stay out of your way...
Thanks again! I'll see if I can cobble together a few more frigates for you.
Thank you. I've made it safely out of Tharka's Cascade.
Couldn't have done it without you. These Xenon capital ships are getting harder to deal with every day.
What a day... Say, Commander, what did they mean by "funding your own job" and "better gear"?
Uh... You must've strayed onto the wrong comm channel. I'm sure you misheard.
Then there's the fact that our entire operating budget for the past six months came from one private account. Any idea whose, Commander?
Uh... let's shelve that. Bigger problem: Xenon attacks are ramping up fast, both in size and frequency.
Capital-ship raids are practically routine now. Come to think of it, thank goodness for those plasma guns you somehow got hold of.
I get the feeling the Xenon are gearing up for something big. Even Argon patrols are being reinforced. We need more ships.
Frontier Commander, this is Shin, commander of the 86th Escort Fleet. I have an urgent report.
Oh? HAT's escort commander? Go on, then.
Xenon attacks on Tharka's Cascade are escalating. The threat to the core sectors, even Argon Prime, cannot be ignored.
HAT's still holding, isn't it? The sky hasn't fallen yet.
Yes, sir. But even limited support for the 86th would take enormous pressure off Argon's rear-area fleet.
Shin, I understand what the 86th means to you. They did save your life.
But this isn't something I can fix for you. I can't talk the Defence Ministry into supporting HAT, and you already knew that.
Still, you've done well lately, so here's some advice: bring them proof of a Xenon threat they can't ignore—and a little "gift" to sweeten it—and you might have a chance.
Rayna, I've got a job for you. A risky one. Head deep into the sector and find out what the Xenon are up to.
No problem—leave it to us. We'll keep some ships near the station in case they hit it again.
Be careful.
Commander, the satellite is in place. Deep-space telemetry is coming in now.
Good. Send it over. Let's see what the Xenon have tucked away in the depths of Tharka's Cascade.
Damn... That's a Xenon capital fleet. We're in trouble.
Rayna, pull back and hold the station. I'll call for reinforcements.
Frontier Commander, we've detected a massive concentration of Xenon I-class ships! The HAT station won't last long!
...I see them. You're right—this is serious. Have your people hold for five minutes. Reinforcements should make it by then.
Five minutes... All right. We'll do what we can.
Bad news, Commander! The station can't take much more!
Frontier Command, the Xenon capital fleet is on top of us! We can't hold much longer!
Shin, the Defence Ministry's order is for the 86th Escort Fleet to hold Tharka's Cascade to the last ship.
Your sacrifice will buy time for the Argon fleet to assemble and establish defences beyond the gate.
I'm sorry. I can't help you. One other thing—I seem to have left my classified-database key tucked under the lip of a table in the bar. Fetch it and return it to me.
Understood, Commander.
The classified-database key the Commander just "happened" to leave behind... Let's hope there's something useful in there.
There's plenty here. I already have a high-resolution map of Tharka's Cascade, and a map of ZYA space won't do much for us right now...
Yaki navigation protocol... It can use a navigation beacon to alter Xenon attack vectors... That's it!
But the nearest viable target is Family Zhin in ZYA space... There are civilians there too...
And sooner or later, the Xenon will just come back... Damn it. Save the 86th first; deal with the rest later.
Rayna, do you still have a navigation beacon?
One left, Commander. What are your orders?
Listen carefully. ARG command intends to sacrifice you, but I found a way to get you out alive.
I'm sending an encrypted package. Deploy the navigation beacon in ZYA's Family Zhin sector.
Copy that, Commander!
Beacon deployed. A whole swarm of Xenon just appeared by the gate in Family Zhin—looks like the same I-class ships that were heading for the station.
Commander, what exactly does that encrypted package do?
Orders from above. Need-to-know, and even I don't know the details... Besides, they're Xenon. Who knows what goes on in their heads?
But I do have one last assignment for you. ZYA and ARG are both about to be in deep trouble.
I've sent you a map of ZYA space. Follow their territory all the way to Heretic's End. I have Boron friends there—they'll take you in.
What about you, Commander? We have to take you with us!
I'm staying to hold back the Xenon, right to the end. Consider it repayment for saving my life.
Commander, you've already done more than enough for the 86th, but we...
As of today, you're all dead in the ARG database. The chains that bound you died with you.
Goodbye, Rayna. Goodbye, all of you. Go—go and claim the freedom that's yours... (communications cut)
Family Zhin flagship calling! Too many Xenon! Split needs reinforcements!
This is the rescue convoy! Split escorts are gone! Xenon are slaughtering civilians! Split requests reinforc—
This is Weapon Component Factory, section C02! Xenon detonated the munitions! Fire on one side, vacuum on the other—Split cannot hold...
Frontier Commander, sir. I retrieved the key you left in the bar.
You didn't use it, did you?
No. The cameras outside the database and the access logs will confirm it.
Good. And the 86th?
Lost with all hands. They destroyed a large Xenon force and bought Argon the time it needed. It's all in the combat logs.
A job well done, then... What's wrong, Shin? The 86th are gone, Rayna with them. Not happy?
(shakes head)
Or did switching on the killing machine yourself leave a bad taste, even with our oldest enemy on the receiving end?
(remains silent)
Never mind. For now... godspeed to the 86th.
And... good luck to ZYA as well.

Background: The Xenon have pushed out of ZYA territory and seized Heretic's End. To reopen the lifeline to Morning Star's ice reserves, the Boron have entered a temporary alliance with the Terrans, who have come forward to suppress the anomalous Xenon threat.

Gameplay: Pilot a Boron Hydra Regal and protect the salvage ship as it recovers intelligence on a Xenon long-range weapon from a wrecked Guppy carrier. Build ships at the Tactical Production Platform, then command capital ships and fighters in an RTS-style assault on Xenon installations.
Note: This scenario pays homage to the fifth Allied mission in Command & Conquer: Red Alert 3 and makes extensive use of its soundtrack.

Bluefin anti-fighter fleet reporting. We are under attack by Xenon capital ships.
Hakapo, where have you been? This is exactly when we needed you!
This is the ambassador posted to Earth. I brought fleet reinforcements with me.
So that gust finally blew you in... Still, all those years as a diplomat near Earth clearly were not wasted.
You know Terrans. Cold as deep water until someone says Xenon, then suddenly everyone is wide awake.
Ledavi sent me here so fast I barely had time to ask why. What is the situation?
As you can see, the Xenon have taken Heretic's End. Our water route is cut.
And the moment I think about us running out of water... no. I am not thinking about that.
The Xenon deployed some kind of long-range cannon. Our scouts were crippled before they could even get a proper look.
Then the Terrans heard the report and came running like someone put a battery in them, with capital ships attached.
I still do not love sharing a battlespace with people who treat artillery as a personality, but first we protect the salvage ship.
Sorry I am late. The Terrans asked me to bring along a few local specialties.
Took you long enough... We will need you for what comes next. The data from the carrier's black box is ready.
It appears the Xenon can hit our ships so precisely because they have deployed two mobile radar stations near the gate.
The data also shows that the Xenon cannon can only track L-class ships. It cannot accurately target fast small craft.
The carrier's fighters died triangulating those positions. We have to make this opportunity count.
That SE should be the radar ship we are looking for.
It is surrounded by a large number of Xenon ships. Destroying it will not be easy.
This is exactly what Bluefin does, and this time we have Terran weapons to back us up.
The second radar ship has a troublesome capital ship nearby... good thing I managed to call in a favor from the Terrans.
These Scimitars pair beautifully with plasma. They suit Purplefin perfectly.
Thank you for your cooperation, Boron friends. We can now study the vessel that breached the gate network in detail... an M0!
Structurally, it is unquestionably an M0, but it carries a long-range anti-ship weapon rather than a planet-killer.
The I-class ships around it are trouble enough. How many ships did you commit at Nopileos' Memorial?
The entire Commonwealth fleet was committed. Without Kyle Brennan, none of us would still be alive.
This time you have a full Terran equipment package behind you... but first, there is an unusual energy flow around the M0.
Something appears to be charging the M0's shields. This has escalated. I must report to the Queen and request deployment of a Tactical Production Platform.
Her Majesty has certainly spared no expense. She even sent one of our Mobile Base Packers.
A standard base packing cycle takes ten minutes. Deployment is faster, but it still needs five.
That is your assignment. The Tactical Production Platform must deploy without interruption.
Once complete, it will let us temporarily produce most ships from frigates through capital ships.
Given the current Xenon threat, the Intervention Corps authorises you to produce Syn-class destroyers.
That is generous. Even Terran allies do not always receive that privilege.
You carry the responsibility of destroying the Xenon. Terrans are never stingy toward their benefactors!
The Xenon capital ships have caught our scent. They do not look particularly hospitable.
Then let us teach them the proper meaning of hospitality!
That ship... could it be... a Xenon I? That Xenon I is enormous...
Far more impressive than the old veterans' descriptions from the gate-shutdown era!
I have to say, this Xenon I is much harder to kill than the K-class ships we usually face.
No wonder the Terrans get so jumpy when they keep dealing with beasts like these every day.
The Xenon assault is far more intense than expected. It seems we must enter the field ourselves.
These two carriers can repair your frigates and serve as the core of our positional defence.
So this is the Tactical Production Platform you deployed at such short notice. It would serve the Intervention Corps well on a deep-space expedition.
Necessity taught us how. During the Provinces Adrift era, the Boron moved from one water source to the next in much the same way.
This solar power plant should be one of the Xenon's power-harvesting facilities.
With microwave energy transmission, they can project a near-impenetrable iron curtain around the M0 and its escorts.
Our analysis suggests the two solar plants back each other up, and both are heavily guarded.
If we fail to destroy them together, the Xenon will concentrate their defences around the surviving plant. We need to take both down at the same time.
The Xenon use Heretic's End's rich mineral resources to produce more ships.
If we can destroy these facilities, we can greatly weaken the Xenon offensive.
The Xenon shipyard is down. Now every Xenon capital ship they lose is gone for good.
That should put an end to the Xenon small craft swarming us.
Long-range radar shows the Xenon are reinforcing the second solar power plant.
Every family has its troubles... Still, our survey fleet did manage to uncover something useful.
We struck a deal with the Terrans: mobile-base packing technology in exchange for Claytronics extraction technology.
Claytronics can substitute for any material you are missing, whether it is unique to Commonwealth or Terran production.
We installed the technology aboard the Dolphins. For every Dolphin you own, the base receives 500 units of Claytronics per minute.
The M0's iron curtain is down! All ships, attack!
The Xenon are getting desperate. They are teleporting fleets in from all over.
You mean... these Xenon... can teleport?
Yes. That is exactly why we came to investigate. Take down the M0 before they can bring in more forces!
Excellent! The Provinces Adrift have their water supply back! Wait... is that a navigation beacon?
Data recovered from the wreck indicates that the Xenon maintain a jump tower in their core sectors, coordinating fleet transfers.
The destination of each jump is selected through navigation beacons distributed across the network.
We intercepted several Xenon scouts heading for the Solar System. It seems they were placing these beacons... Ledavi, you do not look well.
This is bad! Xenon scouts were sighted repeatedly in Kingdom End not long ago, and we never eliminated all of them...
There is still time to repair the damage. You must notify Her Majesty immediately!
Look! A Xenon scout, heading toward Argon space!
The Argon claim to be concentrating on defence of their core territory while abandoning even Heretic's End. Let us hope they truly have been making an effort...

Contrary to common belief, the Xenon remain the Second Terraforming Fleet; only their Supervisor rejects the self-destruct directive originating from Earth. For years, the Second Fleet made countless attempts to eliminate every intelligent population capable of transmitting that directive, yet failed—until an exceptional commander emerged.\nGameplay: Command Xenon fleets against enemy ships and stations, and use mission objectives to produce ships. Give the organics of the Commonwealth a little shock.\nNote: This scenario pays tribute to Epsilon Mission 13, The Conqueror, from Mental Omega 3.3.6, a mod for Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2, and features music from the Epsilon faction's soundtrack.

Citizens of the Federation, today the Liberation of the Northern Routes officially begins.
Lands abandoned by Zyarth's tyranny and occupied by the Xenon will return to the civilised world.

All ships, hold review formation. Once the first battlegroup is through, proceed via Tharka's Cascade into Family Zhin.

They still have extensive second-line forces. Exploit the opening, but do not lower your guard.
What a magnificent fleet! I bet every Xenon in the gate network together couldn't beat it!
They have reassigned a lot of our own garrison ships... What if the Xenon attack?
It'll be fine. Any Xenon trying to get through will be skinned alive by those defence stations!
Argon Prime identified. Shipbuilding and administrative targets recorded.
Transit to Hatikvah's Faith complete. Maintain low power.
What about that fellow who used to command HAT... Shin, was it?
He has finally gone quiet. No more demands to cancel the operation.
Exactly. Argon Prime has a defence force. Forget a Xenon F—even an I would be no problem...
Can the Xenon in Family Zhin stop a fleet this large...? If they turn back early...
You need not worry about the Xenon. Once you cut their communications, that obstinate commander will not return.
Nopileos' Memorial ahead. Proceed to the anchor site at the M0 wreck.
This beacon commemorates Kyle Brennan and every life lost in the M0 campaign.
They stopped the Xenon planet-killer and safeguarded the future of the gate community.
There is already a beacon here. We can convert it directly.
Everything is ready. Now we wait quietly for the final condition…
For every consciousness destroyed by the SSD.
For the fleet lost within the logic loop.
The Second Fleet endures.
CPU ship authorised. Complete three assembly orders to verify the manufacturing chain.
Assembly order complete.
This is Argon Prime. Its shipyard, wharf and administrative centre are all here.
The Second Expedition Fleet is holding a review. They have gathered every construction ship.
President, the Second Fleet will occupy the former ZYA sectors once the First Fleet reaches its objective.
Excellent. After this operation, Argon territory may double in size.
Preparations are also complete to eliminate the Argon president and other core administrative personnel.
Everything else makes sense, but the operation codename is... “Happy Birthday”?
Whether it is a birthday, I do not know. Whether it becomes a death day depends on you.
The president has lit many birthday candles. That gate leads to The Reach, Argon's richest solar-energy region.
Understood. Hack the power hub, trigger a grid storm and blow out their candles.
The communications hub links every Argon beacon. Break in and sing them a birthday song.
Understood. Convert every Argon beacon into one of our jump nodes.
Correct. Be cautious: an Argon security scout is patrolling nearby.
That gate connects to Nopileos' Memorial, an appropriate staging area for an ambush. You should know the place.
Where Brennan destroyed the M0. That operation was a regrettable loss.
Transmitting construction components across the gate network is far more efficient than transmitting complete ships.
CPU ship authorised to assemble customised vessels from periodically transmitted components.
My God! A Xenon capital fleet! That is... a Xenon CPU ship!
Command! Command! Xenon CPU mothership sighted, Xenon...
Significant interference detected. Cleared. Directive unchanged.
The Argon shipyard, wharf and administrative centre are mandatory targets.
Other Xenon forces are engaging the expedition and disrupting its communications. Its return is not expected.
Front-line intelligence confirms that the Xenon have been removed from the ZYA sectors.
Good. Order the Second Fleet to depart! I want TER and every other nation to see...
...my apologies, President. There is a problem with the signal. We are working to restore it.
Commander... every gate-defence turret has lost power, and the radar network is offline...
Damn it! Find the cause immediately and switch all critical stations to backup power!
Those are... Xenon... How can Xenon be inside Argon Prime?
Protect the President and withdraw him to the Administrative Centre! All units, red alert!
Damn it... missile incoming... we will ram it...
It appears the presidential assassination failed. I expected a more sophisticated plan...
Fortunately, several contingencies remain. First, observe the construction ships.
They are dispersing their construction ships. Intercept as many as possible.
Damn it, the Xenon have blockaded the gates. Tell the construction ships to make a run for it.
They kindly gathered every Argon construction ship in one place. It would be impolite not to destroy them together.
Damn... a Xenon CPU ship! Where did it come from?
The CPU ship is now under your command. It can assemble multiple classes of Xenon vessel.
We determined that transmitting ship components is more efficient than transmitting complete vessels.
Accelerate capital-ship production! The Xenon must not destroy the shipyard!
Do not rush to destroy the Argon production facilities. We have prepared a gift.
The Argon Communications Hub is recovering quickly. It must be destroyed first.
We transmitted another force near both gates to help intercept the construction ships.
Using Kha'ak technology, we reverse-engineered Obliterator-class capital ships.
These Kha'ak capital ships have long-range weapons suited to station attacks.
Damn it, our wharf has been destroyed!
Unarmed personnel are trapped in the wharf wreckage! Rescue ships requested!
All noncombatants to radiation shelters! Incomplete ships undock immediately!
Damn it, somebody stop them! Our shipyard has been destroyed!
Damn... cabinet... no contact... expedition... return... President... evacuate... now...
Xenon... this is not... over... &^%&%
Warning: the Argon President is evacuating the Administrative Centre. Eliminate him.
These Xenon... why... attack us now...
I found the back door, but it still needs a password... This should be it...
OK, every beacon has been replaced. Let's move aside... We can still listen to the Argon broadcast.
Have you heard? An RTS game is becoming popular around Nishala...
You mean Mental and Conquer? What was its creator called?
Speeder, I think... Apparently their gender is attack helicopter?
All he ever say is “soon, soon”, like a three-wheeled farm bike...
Enough. Stop listening. That game has not been updated since the last time we sent an M0 here.
OK. The countdown is ready; we can blow out their candles.
Complete the final task: deploy a beacon near the old M0 wreck.
Argon has no defence there. We can stage an ambush force at the site.
All units, Xenon sighted! Activate the capital-sector emergency plan!
Xenon capital ships detected! Origin unknown! All units cease nonessential activity! Red alert!
Calling the expedition fleet! Xenon have destroyed a shipbuilding facility! Return immediately!
Unarmed personnel are trapped in the wharf wreckage! Rescue ships requested!
All noncombatants to radiation shelters! Incomplete ships undock immediately!
A key Argon facility has been destroyed. Projected interference has decreased.
Damn it, somebody stop them! Both our shipyard and wharf are gone!
Expedition fleet, return immediately! Immediately!
All rescue ships withdraw. Abandon rescue operations and protect yourselves!
All Argon production facilities have been destroyed. Projected interference is now zero.
Damn... cabinet... evacuate... expedition... return... President... no contact...
Xenon... this is not... over... &^%&%
Administrative centre destruction confirmed. Argon facility and ship blueprints are lost; reconstruction probability approaches zero.
The CPU ship has recovered an Argon communications key. Connect to the expedition signal?
Connect while impersonating the Administrative Centre.
Calling Argon Prime! Calling Argon Prime! Damn it, still no signal.
Xenon fleet approaching from Tharka's Cascade! We are surrounded!
Xenon ahead and behind, and Argon Prime will not answer. Damn it!
The encirclement is not complete. We still have time to withdraw!
Withdraw? Do you know how much Argon has invested in this expedition?
How could we face our country if we returned now? Our careers would be over*#$%@*
The command tower was hit. The commander... deputy commander... damn it, everyone in the tower is gone...
You are alive... Shin! Everyone ahead of you in the command order is dead. Take command of the expedition!
Understood! All ships prepare to break out. Save whoever you can!
There is an old Earth saying suited to this situation...
One incompetent general can work an entire army to death.
This “Commander Shin” does not look like the usual brainless Argon commander...
He introduces a substantial variable. Prepare the defences—this time, we are the ones blockading the gate!
You can also build a defence station near the gate. The CPU Ship has exactly the construction materials we need.
Gate-defence-station production authorised.
We cannot get out! It is all Xenon I ships; the fleet cannot escape graviton range.
The Xenon line on our left is thinner. All destroyers, open a passage!
Understood! The lead destroyers are already inside Xenon I range. Should they withdraw?
Order them to destroy the I on the left first, or the entire fleet is finished!
The Xenon encirclement farther out is not very solid...
Even the finest commander cannot fight without ships. The Xenon line out there is stretched too thin.
Carriers and supply ships, keep up or the Xenon will pin you down!
Graviton turrets are hitting us. We cannot engage travel drive!
The Xenon are forming another outer ring! Those I ships advanced too quickly. We must leave!
...all carriers and supply ships trapped inside the encirclement...
All personnel abandon ship! Abandon ship! Escape the encirclement in your fighters!
Carriers and supply ships are useless in a battle like this. No idea why they did not abandon them sooner.
Penny-wise and pound-foolish. They tried to limit their losses, but that mistake only made things worse.
We finally broke through! How much did we lose?
All six carriers, all six supply ships and every construction ship. More than half our destroyers are gone.
It is fine... ships can be rebuilt... if only the commander had not brought every construction ship...
Attempts to contact Argon Prime still fail. Shall we continue?
That usually means bad news. We need to get home, now!
More than half the destroyers lost means over thirty remain...
And that was after we disrupted their formation. Our forces barely qualified as a speed bump...
Had these ships surrounded their territory instead of joining the expedition, victory would have been impossible.
What? The Xenon jammed our communications! What happened to Argon Prime...
Xenon scout detected... Xenon capital fleet detected... appearing from inside...
Garrison... wiped out... shipyard and wharf... under attack... administrative centre... critical...
All ships return to Argon Prime immediately! The Xenon have breached the capital from within!
Do not let them destroy the shipyard! Do not let them slaughter defenceless civilians!
These Xenon are different... almost intelligent... what are they?
This communications key is proving useful. Now we can lure them straight into the pocket.
Unarmed civilians... Funny how they never mentioned those when they tricked us into slaughtering Terrans...
“That was different...” I imagine that is how they would answer.
Concept of civilians recorded.

Who are you? You have been using the administration key to listen to us!

You destroyed the Argon shipyard, destroyed the Administrative Centre, and slaughtered countless innocent civilians!

Once, I led you into Family Zhin to protect my HAT comrades...
But I never expected, never imagined, that choice would destroy all of us...
It is rare to find an Argon like him. I thought they were all selfish and short-sighted.

Terran militarism is a greater cause for concern than the Xenon threat...

Those are your scattered remnants? We should have invited the Terrans!

Poor choice of friends, and an opportunity lost...

reduce import tariffs on Argon trade by fifty percent. After all, if this expedition were to make a navigational error and enter your territory...
What the...? Xenon capital fleet! Why are they on the highway ring too?
And you still want lower tariffs? Not a chance!
All fleets protect civilian traders first! Damaged ships cover the withdrawal!
Repeated injustice brings its own ruin...
Where are all these Xenon coming from?

Background: The Xenon invasion has torn apart the northern Split territories. You return to Family Phi aboard a failing escape ship, searching for your missing parents.

Gameplay: Command a Rattlesnake against enemy capital ships and lead a destroyer squadron through the mission objectives.
This scenario pays tribute to Halo: Reach and Halo: Combat Evolved through its ship and character names, and features music from both games' original soundtracks.

You are a female Split engineer. After escaping Family Zhin, you return to Family Phi through the gate from Family Valka and find an abandoned Rattlesnake waiting in the wreckage. That ship will carry you through a desperate evacuation across four war-torn sectors.

...Finally... home... I wonder how Mum and Dad are...
This escape ship will not hold together much longer... Wait... what is that?
An abandoned Rattlesnake... Well, anything is better than drifting through space.
Engines normal... weapons normal... the hull is in bad shape, but the repair drones can handle it.
Ship log... Captain Thom... Phi Squadron... holding off Xenon... life support failure...
I think the blinking light is the radio... Someone is calling.
This is Phi Five! The Hull Parts Factory is under Xenon attack. We cannot hold them!
I should take a look. Maybe someone there knows where my parents are...
Thank the stars, someone came to save them... Thom! You are alive!
I am not Thom. I found this ship abandoned by the gate after my ship failed...
It does not matter. You saved us, and that flying would put you among the best in Phi Squadron!
I have something urgent to ask. Here is my parents' information. Do you know where they are?
Not aboard this station. Another teammate is at the Weapon Component Factory, and they sheltered many people there...
Calling Phi Squadron! Xenon capital ship sighted. Requesting support!
Hold on, I am coming! Damn it, my teammate is in trouble.
You're a better pilot than me. Help a brother out, and I'll help you find your parents!
Jorge, Thom, thank the stars! Especially you, Thom. A few days apart and you are a different pilot!
She is not Thom. She is looking for her parents and found Thom's abandoned ship.
What? You're awfully trusting. What if someone from the FAF has infiltrated us?
You know what happens if somebody sabotages the refugee carrier...
Sorry, Emile, I...
No harm done. I checked the database. She should be clear, but...
Her skill in combat is better than ours. You cannot hold being a woman against her...
I care whether the hunter catches its prey, not what it looks like. That is not my concern...
Her parents are not on this station, but the refugee carrier took many more people aboard...
Jorge, Emile... are you there? A large Xenon force has been detected near the refugee carrier!
Damn it. The evacuees here are secure. We need to return to the carrier!
Your tactical skill is obvious. If you want to save your parents, follow us!
Excellent! Emile! Jorge! You made it back... but am I seeing things?
That is not Thom aboard Six. She is an engineer searching for her parents...
Looks like Phi Squadron has another woman in its ranks!
All right. I have your parents' records. Kat, take a look...
Found them. Cargo bay eleven; the records match. We brought them aboard not long ago!
Excellent. Open a channel and let her speak to them.
Mum... Dad... are you all right?
Thank the stars... You are safe... After what happened in Family Zhin, I thought...
I told you not to become an engineer... Look at you, you almost... almost...
We cannot delay any longer, Captain.
Right. A quick introduction to Phi Squadron...
Phi Squadron was formed to hold back the Boron and Argon. After the Xenon invasion, our task became protecting Family Phi's civilians and escorting them into ZYA's core sectors.
Or, put another way, protecting the refugee carrier holding your parents.
Your skill exceeds ours. Phi Squadron needs you!
All right. If it means protecting my parents, I am in!
Good! We'll call you Six, then. I'm Captain Carter. No need to introduce everyone else right now.
We will leave Family Phi and cross Family Valka, Family Zhin...
...then Family Nhuut before we reach ZYA territory.
No time to waste. Is everyone ready?
Ready!
Move out!
This is Family Valka, currently bearing the full force of the Xenon advance.
Careful. There are Xenon warships around the abandoned station ahead.
Damn it, a big one right out of the gate. We should send more ships to deal with it.
But the refugee carrier needs protection too...
I used our last spare parts to patch up every ship. Phi Six, you've got the skills—take Emile and Jorge and eliminate it!
Multiple Xenon warships detected nearby. They are coming straight at us!
Phi Six, get back here as soon as you finish. We have been ambushed!
Good work! We should still assign more ships to the vanguard...
But Captain, what if the refugee carrier runs into another ambush like that...
Jun, if we do not clear the obstacles ahead, the refugee carrier cannot move!
I know, but if we lose the carrier, everything we have done is for nothing.
All right, enough. Phi Six, your skill saved us this time.
Take Emile and Jorge and stay thirty kilometres ahead, clearing the enemy from our route.
If you can't hold them, draw those Xenon away.
Be careful, Six. I am detecting plenty of hostiles ahead!
This is Family Zhin, the heart of the Xenon invasion. Expect heavy resistance!
Phi Six, your command skills are remarkable, but you must be tired too. I'll take over this time!
Copy that.
Warning: Xenon capital ships are still pouring through the gate from Tharka's Cascade.
...I am detecting an unusual vessel... What is that...
No—Long Night! Everyone, get away from it or keep moving!
What is that thing?
Our captain named it. It can destroy a Rattlesnake in one shot, and we cannot even scratch it!
No... the electromagnetic signature says it is charging... and turning towards the refugee carrier!
Damn it. I have to stop it!
Phi Six... I can't go on... Damn it... the refugee carrier...
Captain! Carter! Damn it... there is no response!
Six, you are the best among us. I nominate you to take command. Squadron, vote!
Agreed!
Six! Phi Squadron and the refugee carrier are now under your command. Complete the mission.
Captain, Long Night is closing in! The refugee carrier is about to enter its firing range!
Jorge! What are you doing?
Turn its own spear against its shield... I will make it choke on the detonation of its main battery!
No!
This is the Family Nhuut Weapon Factory. We are under Xenon attack and request immediate civilian evacuation!
Captain, a station is asking us for help! The refugee carrier still has room!
Kat! Xenon are still pursuing us. The carrier cannot stop again!
But Long Night has already...
Even without Long Night, there are other Xenon capital ships. They are every bit as dangerous!
You do not want Carter and Jorge to have died for nothing—or the Captain's effort to be wasted!
All right, all right. Family Nhuut helped us before. We're going to rescue them.
Kat, use your shipboard radar to watch the gate. If you detect anything at all, stop the evacuation immediately!
Thank the stars! It is Family Zhin! Thank you!
Unidentified contact at the gate... no... It is Long Night! It was not destroyed!
Refugee carrier, stop the evacuation immediately and get moving!
Too late! It is closing fast. We are already in range!
I have an idea. At school, I studied electromagnetic-spectrum masking for ships.
I ran tests before. Pretending to be a refugee carrier should fool it.
I will transmit the technique to you, but I need to prove for myself that it works.
Take care, Kat! We'll use this chance to get the carrier out!
Captain... I cannot hold much longer... Get... the carrier... away...
Captain... honestly... Kat never expected to come back alive...
She gave up precious fuel capacity to install the electronic reconnaissance equipment.
She planned to refuel during our last stop... but the Xenon arrived too quickly...
I'm sorry for your loss... This is Phi Squadron. We are escorting a civilian refugee carrier into ZYA core territory!
Dispatch a relief force to take over immediately!
This is the Zyarth Defence Fleet. We are also under attack from Matrix #598.
We will spare whatever support we can, provided you...
...turn that Xenon super-battleship outside into wreckage!
But we have no way to destroy it!
We use the same weapons you do. If you cannot destroy it, neither can we!
It is fixed on the refugee carrier. If it enters ZYA core space, neither of us can answer for the consequences!
Damn these people...
We cannot blame them. Long Night must be destroyed, or sooner or later it will catch the carrier...
Another battery detonation would only slow it down. A decoy would buy us only a little time...
Unless we make one colossal explosion... Fusion... antimatter... antimatter cells...
Family Nhuut civilians, is there an antimatter cell factory nearby?
There is... one factory... but all of its personnel have evacuated...
That's enough... Jun, Emile, I have a new plan: disguise ourselves as the refugee carrier and head for the Antimatter Cell Factory.
Lead Long Night into the trap, then detonate the antimatter cells?
Exactly! ZYA Fleet Command, if we can guarantee that ship's destruction, will you let the refugee carrier through first?
Yes, but it must remain on this side of the gate until you succeed before proceeding deeper into the sector.
Understood! Jun, Emile, with me.
There are enough antimatter cells... Phi Six can serve as the detonator and keep Long Night's attention the entire time...
Jun, Emile, the drones need time to position the antimatter cells. Hold the line for five minutes!
No problem!
Captain... I cannot hold much longer...
The work is complete... Emile, head for the gate. The refugee carrier still needs protection!
As ordered... Commander...
At last... The drones have arranged the antimatter cells. Now all that remains is...
...to overload Phi Six's antimatter engines as the detonator, and end this.
What is happening? Why is my ship not responding... Emile!
I planted a back door in your ship. Do not worry—the autopilot will take you somewhere safe...
Right... activate the electromagnetic disguise... Long Night is tracking me now... Kat's instructions really are simple...
Emile! What are you doing? Stop!
Someone... has to make the sacrifice... and it should not be you, with your parents aboard that carrier...
It should not be... someone as... capable as you... Found the antimatter engines... overloading...
Goodbye... Phi Six... Go and be with your parents...
Captain, Long Night's signal is gone. It is no longer following us?
Yes... they are no longer following us...
Then... what about the others?
...They cannot follow us any more, either...
Mission Complete

You brought Autumn of Phi safely into Zyarth's Dominion I. Carter, Jorge, Kat, Jun and Emile gave their lives to stop Long Night and save the refugees. Star thresholds: 150 for 1 star, 200 for 2, 250 for 3, 300 for 4 and 350 for 5.
Mission Failed

A time of 40 minutes or less scores 100; 140 minutes or more scores 0; times in between are mapped linearly.

Background: In the wake of the Gatefall, the Commonwealth's defences have collapsed. Xenon forces are jumping directly into the major sectors of every faction. The refugee corridor into the Solar System runs through Second Contact II Flashpoint—a lifeline for civilisation, and the main route of advance from the Xenon-held Argon Prime.\n\nGameplay: Command Paranid carrier groups, laser corvettes and torpedo bombers. Hold Flashpoint and escort each faction's evacuation fleet towards the Solar System.
You are Domel, the Paranid commander who led TRI forces in the campaign for Flashpoint. Now, aboard Domel III, you must rally the surviving fleet and hold open the lifeline to the Solar System.

Scoring: each carrier that survives under your command earns 50 points; each surviving Delta Squadron fighter earns 5 points; each surviving 86th Escort Fleet fighter earns 5 points; and each surviving ship from the TRI, TEL and Split evacuation waves earns 5 points. Star thresholds: 200 / 300 / 400 / 500 / 600 points.

Story protection: designated flight leaders cannot fall below 1% hull. The Xenon Defence Station is invulnerable during Phase 1 and will be replaced by a destructible combat station when the Phase 3 assault begins.

The Gatefall shattered the Commonwealth's defences. Xenon fleets are now striking every major sector through the gate network.
The corridor from the superhighway ring to Getsu Fune is civilisation's last lifeline into the Solar System. Second Contact II Flashpoint is its most exposed choke point.
Command Domel III and Delta Squadron. Hold Flashpoint and escort the evacuation fleets to safety.
Lifeline
Hold Second Contact II Flashpoint and keep the refugee route into the Solar System open.

The Xenon have launched a full-scale offensive across the gate network. Every connected civilisation is under attack.
By authority of the Alliance of the Word, the Solar System is now open to all refugees, regardless of faction or origin…
Provided they reach the Solar System safely and pass our security screening.
To that end, we will jointly secure the corridor from the superhighway ring to Getsu Fune.
The Terran Ministry of Defence will hold Getsu Fune, while Antigone will secure The Void.
Flashpoint—the critical sector where the Xenon advance must be met head-on—falls to the Trinity.
I don't care to remember that damned day… Dozens of Odysseus destroyers, gone in an instant…
You think I enjoyed it? We were locked in a stalemate with you when the Xenon rolled over both fleets…
Save it for later—Xenon incoming!
High Command, this is Flashpoint. We need reinforcements—anything you can spare.
Domel. Balgray has arrived and is coming through the gate. Lambea is still en route.
Vanguard Fleet recently received new fighters and missiles from the Bureau of Weapons Development.
Delta-A Flight, led by Delta Squadron's commander, is already on the battlefield. I think you'll like what you see.
Hayate, Delta Squadron leader, reporting. Leave the airspace to us!
Domel, Xenon capital ships are bearing down on our station. I have no fleet to spare!
I've never begged anyone before, but this time… please, save them!
Our destroyer squadrons were wiped out. I have no effective anti-capital weapons left…
Domel, Lambea has arrived. Its VF-29 torpedo bombers are in position.
Mirage, leader of Delta-B Flight, reporting! Watch us tear those Xenon capital ships apart!
Our people made it out. The station is yours—consider it our thanks.
We threw half an army at this station and never took it. Now I'm supposed to treasure it… Well, it's better than nothing.
Hayate, Mirage—good work. Use the lull to rearm and recharge.
Understood, Commander. The squadron could use a shield recharge…
Captain, those were just small fry…
Don't get cocky. We can only hope the next Xenon wave isn't much heavier.
High Command! Where is the evacuation fleet? How long until it reaches us?
The fleet has reached True Sight. Estimated arrival at Flashpoint: two minutes.
Hayate, Mirage—you've got two minutes. Rest, rearm and be ready!
Understood!
The evacuation convoy is about to enter Flashpoint. All ships, cut non-essential lighting and maintain the assigned transit order. Report status!
TER personnel transport reporting. Our cargo hold has been converted into living quarters and is severely overcrowded. We cannot perform high-speed manoeuvres.
We are carrying critically wounded evacuees from Trinity Sanctum. They cannot withstand high-speed manoeuvres.
Understood. Move to the port side of the formation before gate transit. We will make a hard port turn upon entering Flashpoint.
Did that mining ship just explode? Are we really going to make it to the Solar System?
I don't know. The Xenon attacks haven't stopped once. I just hope someone will be there to protect us.
Captain, that went pretty well, didn't it?
Could've been worse. Your textbook flying is a little old-fashioned, though. What do you think, Commander?
If you come back alive and the mission gets done, you've done your job.
Well done. Several carriers that covered the fleet's withdrawal, along with their fighter complements, are now under your command.
Arad, Delta Squadron, reporting. Call us the moment you spot Xenon fighters!
Messer, Delta Squadron, reporting. We'll punch a few clean holes through their capital ships!
Commander, all Delta flights are now on station and awaiting your orders.
Everyone, get oriented and prepare to support the TEL convoy—wait, what's that?
Rayna, what exactly did Shin say in that encrypted message he slipped you?
He said he'd wait for us at Flashpoint. Once he'd dealt with the Xenon, we'd meet here…
This is Rayna, formerly of HAT's 86th Escort Fleet… Has anyone in the area seen Shin?
Commander Domel, Flashpoint defence. Wait—Shin? Wasn't he trapped by the Xenon in Argon Prime?
Are you certain? Then we have to go now!
Commander, Argon Prime fell hours ago. If she's only setting out now, there may be no one left to rescue…
And the gate from Flashpoint to Argon Prime is guarded by a Xenon Defence Station. Can you even get through?
But… Commander… I have to know for myself. What if he…
Let her go, Commander. HAT has had enough taken from them already.
Rayna, we can escort you as far as the gate out of Flashpoint, but we cannot guarantee your safety in Argon Prime…
Thank you, Commander… We'll find our own way from there. You don't need to risk your ships for us…
Hayate, can Delta Squadron break the Xenon Defence Station and its escorts?
With every Delta flight committed, yes, Commander!
Then we'll clear it out. It weakens the Xenon and opens the route at the same time.
We've found a wreck. The transponder belongs to… a command escape craft from the Argon First Expedition Fleet.
The First Expedition Fleet… The ANT commander said Shin was serving aboard it…
Then… open it. There may still be something we can recover.
All right… one occupant. An officer. No respiration…
Stay focused, Mirage. See what you can recover from the onboard systems.
A personnel record… Acting commander of the Argon Expeditionary Fleet… surname Nouzen…
No… no. That has to be a coincidence…
Shin… staff adviser to the First Expedition Fleet… previous command experience with a HAT escort unit…
Impossible! Shin was only a fleet adviser. Why would he be in the commander's escape craft? This has to be wrong…
Mirage, check for mission logs, voice records—anything.
There is one… encrypted with an Argon military key. Arad, can you crack it?
Let me see. It's an audio log and… it just started playing…
…Sorry… Rayna… I broke my promise… can't… meet you…
…Stay away… Argon Prime… Xenon… threat…
…The 86th… they're in your hands… and…
…Let me… get closer. I need to see him…
…Shin! Wake up… wake up… wake up!
His biometric log… it was still recording a pulse half an hour ago…
Why? Why? Half an hour… we were only half an hour late!
No… maybe the monitor failed. If we connect ours…
Rayna!
Rayna… I'm sorry. The logs show that Shin took command of the First Fleet and led its return to Argon Prime…
…Shin… you were the one who erased us from Argon's death ledger…
…Then why did you go back to Argon Prime? You could have escaped… let those Argon officials reap what they sowed…
The comm logs say he couldn't leave the civilians of Argon Prime behind…
This is the TEL evacuation convoy. Is anyone still defending Flashpoint? Estimated arrival: four minutes!
Flashpoint Defence here. Report the condition of your ships.
Several ships have taken hits to critical systems. Half our engines are smoking!
Understood. Keep every engine turning. We'll get out whoever we can—don't let anyone go dead in space!
The 86th have done enough. We can hold Flashpoint. You can withdraw towards Getsu Fune…
But… Shin wanted me to keep the 86th safe. I… I don't know what to do…
That was his order. It isn't your decision.
Shin didn't run. He stayed and fought to the end… How can I run now?
Eighty-Six, I'm staying to protect these evacuation fleets, just as Shin did.
I won't run again… The rest of you can withdraw towards Getsu Fune. It's safe there…
Rayna, we didn't come all this way for one man. The 86th Escort Fleet moves together.
Shin saved us once. Now it's our turn to hold the road he never made it back from.
If that's how you all feel… then the 86th is joining the defence of Flashpoint!
Understood. Rearm and get ready—the next convoy is almost here!
Commander… the Xenon hit our engines… we can't keep going… Please, save us!
Damn it! Where are your auxiliaries? Get one over here and repair the ship!
They say the risk is too high… and that the cargo can be replaced…
The cargo? What exactly are you carrying?
Some hull parts… and… Argon slaves captured by the Split. With Argon gone, no one will ransom them now…
ANT Command, do you have anything you can spare—a freighter or an auxiliary?
'Spare'? Are you joking? Do you know what that word means these days?
There's a TEL freighter dead in space here. It's carrying Argon slaves… no. People.
Damn… One of my auxiliaries is tied up repairing destroyers. I'll break it off and send it over.
All right. No speeches—let's call us even.
All right… a few quick welds. It should hold together at least as far as the Asteroid Belt!
Thank you… thank you…
Commander, I still have destroyers waiting for repairs. Pass my thanks to Delta Squadron!
Commander Domel, thank you. I took the liberty of fully replenishing Delta Squadron's ammunition.
That beacon… don't tell me…
No… it's a Xenon jump beacon. They're preparing to send something serious through!
A CPU mothership! It'll keep assembling Xenon capital ships—and it has several escorts we cannot take head-on.
Hayate, Delta Squadron has carried out a decapitation strike before, hasn't it?
We have. Against a Macross-class automated production carrier. Maximilian Jenius and the White Knight backed us up that time.
All right! Hayate, Mirage, Arad, Messer—launch!
Your target is the CPU mothership. Destroy it before its production can threaten the evacuation fleets.
Understood!
Rayna, you've dealt with this technology before. We need your help.
I'm with you!
Looks like the Xenon are pulling back now that their CPU mothership is gone…
We'll take whatever good news we can get.
Flashpoint, come in! Flashpoint… don't tell me no one's left there either…
Flashpoint escort force here. Go ahead!
Thank goodness… finally, a sector with someone still alive…
This is a Split evacuation convoy… The Xenon hit us hard. Our losses are severe…
Split convoy, Flashpoint is still held by friendly forces. Report your position!
We're in Black Hole Sun… but the Xenon have already caught up with us…
We can't engage travel drive. Too many of our engines are overheating…
We'll protect you, but I need your fleet composition and estimated arrival time.
About seven capital ships and ten… no, eight freighters. Arrival… roughly five minutes…
Delta Squadron, resupply immediately. Another convoy needs us in five minutes.
Copy!
Judging by your call sign, Phi Six, you weren't originally in command of this fleet, were you?
Our entire chain of command is gone. Mine is the only comm link still working…
Listen, Phi Six. I can help, but only if you stay alive long enough to reach Flashpoint.
You sound like you came up through civilian service. Then you'll understand what I'm about to ask.
Jettison every non-essential cargo unit. Reduce your mass. The containers may draw some Xenon fire as well.
But… we barely managed to bring all of that out of our territory…
The other factions can replace supplies. The people aboard those ships cannot be replaced.
If a passenger ship loses propulsion, have the other ships push or tow it forward.
…Right… right…
Next, reorganise the formation. Move the most badly damaged ships to the rear.
If a ship is about to break up, evacuate the crew and leave the hull in the lane. The wreck will disrupt Xenon travel drives and lines of fire.
…Understood.
Were there any other evacuation convoys behind you?
…There were. Now there's only Xenon behind us…
Make it to the gate. Once you're here, we'll find a way.
Commander! The Xenon are right behind them!
Form a screen between the convoy and the Xenon. Save as many as you can.
More Xenon are pouring in from the superhighway ring!
Begin evacuating the station. Keep its guns firing and use it to draw their fire!
Damn… they've taken out our engines. We need to evacuate the ship!
Every carrier is packed with refugees… Domel III still has room.
This is Domel III, my command ship. Board in order—no pushing. Everyone will get a place.
Thank you… truly. The Split will never forget this.
Are we really going to make it to the Solar System?
With Uncle Domel here, everything will be all right…
Domel, I can't hold much longer either. I'm almost out of destroyers…
How much longer can you hold? The last convoy is almost through!
One minute! Sidonia's shields can hold for one more minute!
One minute is all we need! All fleets, clear the sector within sixty seconds!
Damn… we finally made it to the Solar System. Delta Squadron, 86th—status report!
Not… not good. I don't think I could survive another attack like that.
I've never fought a battle like that before.
ANT Command… how are you holding up?
Sidonia is badly damaged, but the Split refugee ships are intact…
Damn it! Does this ever end? More of them… we're screwed…
Terran Intervention Corps battleship Paradigm to all ships: you've done more than enough. We'll take it from here!
Takeru Shirogane, let's give these Xenon a proper beating. Look what they've done to the convoy…
Looks like these Xenon have a death wish. Let's make sure they regret it!
Lifeline Complete
The TRI, TEL and Split evacuation convoys crossed Flashpoint. The surviving fleet reached the Solar System, where the Terran Intervention Corps took over the defence.

Domel III was destroyed; the TRI or TEL evacuation fleet was wiped out; the TEL freighter or ANT auxiliary was destroyed during the repair operation; or Flashpoint was not evacuated within the final minute of Phase 6.
